name: Edge Transformations for Improving Mesh Quality of Marching Cubes
definition: A method that improves the mesh quality of Marching Cubes by applying gradient and tangential edge transforms to vertex positions before final intersection calculation, reducing degenerate triangles.
summary: Macet improves Marching Cubes mesh quality by repositioning active edge endpoints via gradient and tangential transformations before intersection, preserving topology while eliminating degenerate triangles.
